title: Supreme Court urges Railways to stop calling travellers second-class passengers
description: The Supreme Court on Friday suggested that Indian Railways reconsider its use of the expression “second-class passenger”, observing that a class label should describe the coach in which a person travels and not the person [Lata v. Union of India and Another].A Bench of Justices Sanjay Karol and N Kotiswar Singh said that such a description was problematic in light of India’s history of class divisions and the constitutional commitment to equality.“While it is ostensibly linked to the expenditure
